title: Rhythm Garden
pitch: Tap four animated flowers to a short original rhythm, then watch the garden bloom from your performance.
capabilities: Rive character timing and coordinated artboards
rules: Four lanes; hits judged against an audio-time schedule with explicit windows.

Pause saves progress at a phrase boundary; no promise of sample-exact resume after device audio suspension.
content: Three short original tracks, practice mode, tap calibration and a visual-only practice option.
